The severity of 2.0 is appropriate—it's noticeable but doesn't destroy the subject's identity. The topology mask confirms the frog is a single coherent object, ruling out major fragmentation. The low-confidence keypoints in the front limbs (shoulders) from the pose auditor correlate with the Router's observation of 'soft/undefined' joints, reinforcing the structural weakness in that area.
